title: Redis Caching Middleware
goal: Implement Redis-based caching middleware for public API endpoints to reduce database load, improve response times, and handle traffic spikes.

sub_tasks.title: Create Cache Middleware Factory
sub_tasks.output: Implemented cache() middleware factory with configurable TTL and custom key generation

sub_tasks.title: Implement Cache Hit/Miss Logic
sub_tasks.output: Cache middleware checks Redis for cached response, returns if found, otherwise intercepts res.json to cache response

sub_tasks.title: Add X-Cache Header
sub_tasks.output: Responses include X-Cache: HIT or X-Cache: MISS header for cache debugging

sub_tasks.title: Integrate with Redis Utils
sub_tasks.output: Cache middleware uses cacheGet/cacheSet from utils/redis for Redis operations

acceptance_criteria: Cache middleware works only for GET requests
X-Cache header indicates HIT or MISS
Applies to public API endpoints (properties, locations, testimonials)
result_summary: Redis caching layer implemented for performance optimization. Cache middleware intelligently caches GET responses with configurable TTL. Public API endpoints (properties list, featured properties, locations) benefit from significantly reduced database queries and faster response times. X-Cache header enables monitoring cache effectiveness. Graceful fallback ensures service continuity if Redis fails.
